fee_assumption: ZERO_FEE_OPTIMISTIC_BOUND; excludes pool fee, gas, failed tx, sandwich, nonce, delay to observe finality and MEV
formula: token_out = floor(Rtoken_buy * inputBNB / (Rbnb_buy + inputBNB)); bnb_out = floor(Rbnb_exit * token_out / (Rtoken_exit + token_out)); scenario BNB delta = bnb_out - inputBNB. Ignores trader perturbation of intermediate reserves, assumes reserves snapshots unaffected by follower; exploratory only.
comparison_principle: Keep token/amount/lag all fixed and include every result regardless of direction. First-out is partial exit only. Pool identity must be independently checked. Full-life strategy replay not done.
output_gate: No production inference; if pool reserve < intended buy size preserve raw arithmetic and flag non-executable as illiquid instead of dropping it.
